curatedMovie.curiosityHook: A rescue on the open sea should offer relief, but what terrible reality is this frantic survivor fleeing on his sinking ship?
curatedMovie.description: Grieving the sudden death of their son, an Australian couple takes a Pacific sailing voyage to heal, only to encounter a sinking vessel and take in a lone survivor hiding dangerous secrets.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Tense and emotionally heavy; a compact, mid-paced ocean thriller tailored for focused, solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Phillip Noyce crafts a taut maritime thriller that transforms vast ocean isolation into an intense, suspenseful chamber piece fueled by raw grief and immediate peril.
